manaNeeded: {6}{G}{G}{U}{U} if each opponent has three or more poison counters, or {8}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U} otherwise
description:
Cast Triumph of the Hordes by paying {2}{G}{G}, giving creatures you control +1/+1 and infect until end of turn.
Cast Echo of Eons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing each player to discard their hands and draw seven cards.
Nekusar triggers for each card your opponents draw.
Resolve the first trigger, causing the opponent to get a poison counter.
If the opponent has ten or more poison counters, they lose the game as a state-based action.
Repeat from step 4 for each remaining trigger.
If needed, cast Echo of Eons from your graveyard for its flashback cost by paying {2}{U}, causing each player to discard their hands and draw seven cards.
Repeat from step 3.
